{"metadata":{"description":"DASH — Deepseek Agentic Service Harness, a TUI Plugin of Deepseek Harness","id":"gh:1333652448","install_available":false,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dash","slug":"songqikong/dash","topics":["dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DASH — Deepseek Agentic Service Harness, a TUI Plugin of Deepseek Harness"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# DASH — Deepseek Agentic Service Harness"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"A terminal TUI for the official dsh CLI,
launched as a dsh profile like dsh-tui,
but with keybinding"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"s, editing semantics, the status bar and the settings panel
following oh-my-pi conventions. The kern"},{"id":"p3s3","text":"el is pure DSH: the plugin creates real
agents through the official `ctx.agents.create()` factory, d"},{"id":"p3s4","text":"rives turns with
`agent.followup()`, interrupts with `agent.cancel()`, and renders the streaming
`se"},{"id":"p3s5","text":"ssion/event` event flow. Tool calls, reasoning, session persistence,
compaction and agent presets al"},{"id":"p3s6","text":"l go through DSH's official services. The UI is
zero-dependency raw-ANSI terminal rendering (no Reac"},{"id":"p3s7","text":"t/Ink) — the whole plugin
lives in a single `index.ts`."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Prerequisite: the official `dsh` CLI (`npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh`)."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"`DASH_PROVIDER` / `DASH_MODEL` environment variables override the default
model; LLM provider config"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"uration is fully reused from `$DSH_HOME/settings.yaml`
(the same file the Web Models page writes) — "},{"id":"p7s3","text":"no separate setup needed."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## One TUI, _official DSH end to end_"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"### 01 · Native terminal rendering, zero deps"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"The whole UI is raw ANSI: diff rendering redraws only changed rows, the kitty
keyboard protocol (CSI"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"-u) gives per-key precision, SGR mouse support (wheel
scrolling, moving the selection in list overla"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"ys), alternate screen plus a
hidden hardware cursor. No React/Ink, no node_modules baggage — the plu"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"gin body
is one file and its only runtime dependencies are the official DSH packages."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"### 02 · Full oh-my-pi-style editing"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Multi-line input (kitty Shift+Enter / Ctrl+J), word/line movement and deletion,
kill-ring (Ctrl+Y / "},{"id":"p12s2","text":"Alt+Y yank-pop), undo (Ctrl+-), char jump (Ctrl+] /
Ctrl+Alt+]), Ctrl+G external-editor round-trip, "},{"id":"p12s3","text":"paste, `@` file completion
(recursive into directories). All keybindings come from oh-my-pi's action"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"
table and can be remapped in `~/.dash/keybindings.yml`; `/hotkeys` shows the
active bindings."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"### 03 · Streaming transcript"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Markdown rendering (headings/lists/quotes/code highlighting/tables/links,
stream-safe — unclosed cod"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"e blocks and tables degrade to plain paragraphs
instead of breaking the frame), streamed reasoning f"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"olding (Ctrl+T toggles),
tool cards (⛭/✓/✗ states, arg folding Ctrl+O, result summaries), message
me"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"tadata (time/duration/model), pinned prompt header plus a ↓N unread pill
while browsing history."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"### 04 · Status-bar dashboard"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"omp-style status lines: **A** (above the input) shows `⬢ model · preset · ◉
thinking effort · in/out"},{"id":"p16s2","text":" tokens`, **C** (below the input, the bottom row) shows
activity (spinner + ⛭ tool name / ⏵ model se"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"lf-reported work / ✓ turn stats),
queue, status hints, and `/help`. Both rows sit on a theme backgro"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"und band with
balanced left/right segments — the right side carries the TPS sparkline, cache
hit %, "},{"id":"p16s5","text":"session elapsed, the restored **context-window indicator** (usage/total
+ a 10-cell bar), and git br"},{"id":"p16s6","text":"anch / cwd / session title."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"### 05 · Model role system"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Four roles — default / smol / plan / task — with values supporting a
`provider/model:effort` suffix,"},{"id":"p18s2","text":" persisted to `modelRoles` in
`~/.dash/config.yml`. Three-column picker (Alt+M, Tab moves columns · "},{"id":"p18s3","text":"j/k
move · Enter drills down), Ctrl+P cycles the current role's model, Alt+P
swaps in a temporary mo"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"del, Shift+Tab cycles thinking effort. The default
effort is configurable in the settings panel."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"### 06 · Session workflow"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"`/resume` picker (sorted by mtime, parallel title loading, Enter restores with
event-log replay, `d`"},{"id":"p20s2","text":" deletes dash-* sessions), `/rename`, `/new`,
persistence (`~/.dsh/sessions`), `autoResume` restores"},{"id":"p20s3","text":" the most recent session
at startup. Double-Esc enters time-rewind: fork a seed session from the
ses"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"sion log, drop that message back into the editor, edit and resend
(omp's rewind semantics)."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"### 07 · Official agent preset modes"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"DSH's four official agent modes are directly available: **Standard** (full
featured), **PTC** (Code "},{"id":"p22s2","text":"Mode SDK), **Minimal** (persistent bash +
str_replace_editor only), **Creative** (preset authoring)."},{"id":"p22s3","text":" Switch via the
`/preset` picker or the «Session mode» settings item; blank sessions rebuild
immedia"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"tely, sessions with history take effect after `/new`; the choice is
persisted as `preset.id`. Loadin"},{"id":"p22s5","text":"g uses the official
`discoverPresets` / `mountPreset` in the agent factory's `setup` hook."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"### 08 · omp-style settings panel"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"`/settings` is a full port of oh-my-pi's SettingsList interaction: four tabs
(appearance / model / i"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"nteraction / session) with a grouped sidebar (two or
more groups split left/right, inactive groups d"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"immed), type-to-search fuzzy
search across tabs (Tab jumps to the next matching tab), Enter/Space cy"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"cles
values, a 3-line description area, change markers, Esc backs out of search
before closing. 12 r"},{"id":"p24s5","text":"eal knobs (language, theme, color-blind mode, spinner
frames, default thinking effort, hide reasonin"},{"id":"p24s6","text":"g, advisor, double-Esc, queue
delivery, turn bell, quiet boot, autoResume) — all applied live and wr"},{"id":"p24s7","text":"itten to
`~/.dash/config.yml`."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"### 08½ · Splash welcome screen"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"Before the session starts you get an omp-style welcome screen: a sharp-cornered
single column box (n"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"o rounded elements, everything centered) with a bold DASH
wordmark (ANSI Shadow art) + model/provide"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"r, then a Tips block (all hints live
inside the box), the current agent preset (**highlighted** — it"},{"id":"p26s4","text":" also appears on
status line A above the input), and recent sessions (read live from
`~/.dsh/session"},{"id":"p26s5","text":"s` with relative times). It yields to the transcript once the
first message is sent."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"### 09 · Agent Hub"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"Alt+A / `/hub` opens the subagent tree: indentation, label, mode,
running/inactive states, filtering"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"; Enter shows details, `s` messages a
subagent (followup), `x` interrupts it (ancestor authorization"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"Enter shows details, `s` messages a
subagent (followup), `x` interrupts it (ancestor authorization)."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"### 10 · Advisor — second-model bystander"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"`/advisor on` enables it: after every turn the second model posts a short
comment on that turn (pref"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"ixed `advisor:`), visible in the main transcript."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"### 11 · TTSR — time-travel streaming rules"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"Write regex → prompt pairs in `~/.dash/rules.yml`. When streaming output hits
